|===

What each backend states on constant time, as the capability table read it:

* `bearssl`: BearSSL at webcpp::crypto's pin: bearssl_hmac.h states constant time for br_hmac_outCT alone; mac calls br_hmac_out.
* `hash2`: Boost.Hash2 1.92: its headers (boost/hash2/) state no constant-time property.
* `openssl`: OpenSSL 3.5.9: doc/man3/EVP_MAC.pod, doc/man7/EVP_MAC-HMAC.pod, EVP_MAC-KMAC.pod, EVP_MAC-BLAKE2.pod, EVP_MAC-Siphash.pod and providers/implementations/macs/ state no constant-time property.
* `sodium`: libsodium 1.0.22: its headers state constant time for comparisons (sodium/utils.h) alone, not for its hashing, MAC, key derivation and password hashing functions (crypto_hash_*, crypto_xof_*, crypto_generichash_*, crypto_shorthash_*, crypto_auth_*, crypto_kdf_*, crypto_pwhash_*).
* `webcrypto`: The Web Cryptography API (W3C Recommendation, 2017) states no constant-time property of digest, sign or deriveBits; each JavaScript runtime's implementation decides, and webcpp reads none.

`macs::hmac<digests::keccak_224>` has no default backend: the call names one of its backends (<<hash-default-backend>>).

`macs::hmac<digests::keccak_256>` has no default backend: the call names one of its backends (<<hash-default-backend>>).

`macs::hmac<digests::keccak_384>` has no default backend: the call names one of its backends (<<hash-default-backend>>).

`macs::hmac<digests::keccak_512>` has no default backend: the call names one of its backends (<<hash-default-backend>>).

`macs::hmac<digests::sm3>` has no default backend: the call names one of its backends (<<hash-default-backend>>).

The default of `macs::hmac<digests::md5>`, `macs::hmac<digests::sha1>`, `macs::hmac<digests::sha2_224>` and `macs::hmac<digests::sha2_384>`: `hash2` on every target, whatever the program links; `bearssl`, `openssl` only where the call names it, as its second template argument (<<hash-default-backend>>).

The default of `macs::hmac<digests::sha2_256>` and `macs::hmac<digests::sha2_512>`: `hash2` on every target, whatever the program links; `bearssl`, `openssl`, `sodium` only where the call names it, as its second template argument (<<hash-default-backend>>).

The default of `macs::hmac<digests::sha2_512_224>`, `macs::hmac<digests::sha2_512_256>`, `macs::hmac<digests::sha3_224>`, `macs::hmac<digests::sha3_256>`, `macs::hmac<digests::sha3_384>`, `macs::hmac<digests::sha3_512>`, `macs::hmac<digests::ripemd_160>`, `macs::hmac<digests::blake2b>` and `macs::hmac<digests::blake2s_256>`: `hash2` on every target, whatever the program links; `openssl` only where the call names it, as its second template argument (<<hash-default-backend>>).

`webcrypto` serves the asynchronous family alone, on Emscripten, where the type of its asynchronous call names it (<<hash-async-webcrypto>>).
